children: Pro Medicus's steady flow of contract wins helps turn Morgans analyst Iain Wilkie even more bullish on the medical-tech provider. Raising his recommendation to buy from accumulate, Wilkie tells clients in a note that the consistency of modest wins indicate that the Australian company has a repeatable mid-market playbook. This is broadening its opportunity pipeline, he adds. Wilkie says three new community health deals so far in FY 2027 represent a steady start to the period. Morgans maintains a target price of 230.00 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.2% at A$178.01. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
